title: Nonnegativity of the spectral one-norm
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$ and every real-valued function $f$ on the Boolean cube $\{0,1\}^n$, the sum of the absolute values of its Fourier–Walsh coefficients is nonnegative: $\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}|\widehat f(S)|\ge 0$.
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$, $I=\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and $f:\{0,1\}^I\to\mathbb R$.
Then its spectral one-norm is nonnegative:
\[
\sum_{S\subseteq I}|\widehat f(S)|\ge0,
\qquad \widehat f(S)=2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^I}f(x)\prod_{i\in S}(-1)^{x_i}.
\]
